descriptions.normal: Appearing without fanfare at the tea party is an exquisitely crafted two-tiered assortment of pastries... Could she really have made this herself? Before the surprise in your eyes has time to fade, she folds her arms, turns slightly aside, and lifts her chin. "Hah? What's that look for? They're only tea snacks. Hardly a challenge." A faint, delicate sweetness drifts through the air, as if silently backing up her claim. Well then, best not keep them waiting!

effectTexts.normal: Decreases all party members' climbing and sprinting Stamina consumption by 25% for 1500s.
